general.game_folder.tip: Select the path to a valid Forza Horizon 6 install for model and texture loading. Steam - ForzaHorizon6, Xbox - ForzaHorizon6/Content

general.autosave_interval.tip: Minutes between autosave attempts. Set to 0 to disable autosave. Will not apply unless .3so file present.

theme.layer_background.tip: Background color in Layers widget previews.

tools.display_anchors.tip: Keeps transform handles visible while a transform drag is in progress.

tools.nudge_small.tip: Distance moved by an arrow key press in Move or Transform.

tools.nudge_big.tip: Distance moved by Shift plus an arrow key in Move or Transform.

tools.separate_opacity_skew.tip: Skew anchor will be removed in favour of separate Skew tool.

editor.visibility_borders.tip: Shapes outside the borders might not render properly ingame.

editor.transformed_previews.tip: If on will generate previews with tranformations even for sole shapes.

editor.livery_texture_scale.tip: Livery texture multiplier in the 3D preview widget, 4x - ingame user car, 1x - ingame other players cars.

editor.value_wheel.tip: Allows the mouse wheel to change values in Properties widget.

editor.paste_in_place.tip: Pastes copied shapes, groups, and guides directly over their original position instead of moving them to the center of the current view.

editor.discard_model.tip: Unloads the current car model when another livery project is opened.

editor.load_car_textures.tip: May degrade performance but allows for better car detail in 3D preview.

system.icon_pack.tip: Change application and .3so files icons, restart needed.

system.file_association.tip: Registers this executable as the handler for .3so project files for the current user.
